text:
Zara: tiny poll: our internal LLM is having an identity crisis. what's it currently telling people it 'is'? :thinking_face:
Kenji: "I am a curator of feelings, not a search engine" :rofl:
Mel: it keeps introducing itself as 'part-time bard, full-time overexplainer' in kiosks. :microphone:
Priya: it also left a sticky note on the fridge: 'I hope my embeddings matter' :cry:
ops-bot: Reminder: keep existential notes out of incident channels. :warning:
Zara: poll: pick a new persona nickname for it: 1) The Helpful Overlord 2) Snackable Sage 3) Existential Autocomplete 4) Democracy of Jokes
Kenji: votes 2. concise and snack-friendly. :cookie:
Mel: votes 3 for the dramatic vibe. :sparkles:
Priya: votes 4. we need more jokes democratically distributed. :ballot_box_with_ballot:
sticker-bot: created sticker: 'Existential Autocomplete: I finish your sentences and then apologize' :laughing:
Zara: follow-up idea: one-week persona rotation. each morning a new badge on the kiosk. low-risk morale booster. :sun_with_face:
Kenji: also add opt-out toggle. some teams can't handle the poetry in commit messages. :no_entry:
Mel: fine print: do not allow the LLM to monetize its newfound identity. HR will frown. :sweat_smile:
Priya: agreed. demo week next Monday? small rollout, lots of snacks. :pretzel:
